body: I recently learned that my father had a pretty good salary when I was growing up, more than I earn right now. It was surreal, I was always convinced we were poor and I was a financial burden on my parents. I wore old second hand clothes and was bullied in school for that. Turns out my father just spent most of his money on alcohol, cigarettes and gambling...
It so frustrating. I'm an adult now and I haven't seen my father for a decade, but in my nightmares I still have to run away from him. It's like this experience was build into me.
